name: DWD Open Data Server: hourly station observations (Germany)
short: Hourly German station observations as per-station CSV files. No key; CC BY 4.0.
summary: The Deutscher Wetterdienst Open Data Server at opendata.dwd.de lists files over plain HTTPS with no login. The folder weather/weather_reports/poi/ holds one CSV per station (974 CSV links on 2026-11-07), e.g. 10384-BEOB.csv, with a recent hourly series in UTC. A pull on 2026-11-07 returned rows stamped 15:00 to 17:00 UTC with cloud cover, 2 m temperature, visibility, wind direction, pressure and humidity; many columns are blank ('---') for stations without that sensor, and some stations (10382) were all blank. The same server carries model forecasts, radar and climate data in other folders (not called).

tasks: hourly station observations for Germany (temperature, wind, visibility, pressure, humidity, cloud cover)

coverage.notes: Station list is large but coverage per file varies; blank '---' values are normal. Germany and nearby synoptic stations.

rate_limit.notes: No numeric limit stated on the pages read; the server is a public file index, be polite and cache by file timestamp.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: station file rows for 15:00, 16:00 and 17:00 UTC, directory listing timestamped 17:42 UTC.

latency.typical: About an hour after observation time
latency.notes: Directory index shows file modification times so you can poll only changed files.

licensing.summary: Per the DWD legal notice (dwd.de, rechtliche Hinweise): all freely accessible geodata and geodata services, including meteorological weather information with location, may be reused under Creative Commons BY 4.0 with a source credit. Weather and climate data are largely free of charge under the DWD Act of 2017. Check the notice for the exact source-credit wording; resale and AI training are not separately addressed.

time.unknown: Report time is the provider's own stamp.
time.method: Date and UTC time columns in each row.

location.unknown: Station location comes from DWD station lists, not from these files; not called here.
location.method: Station number in the file name; coordinates are in the station list, not in the CSV.

content.unknown: Agency values; no independent check documented.
content.method: Official instrument readings published by the national weather service.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

endpoints.notes: Apache index of per-station CSV files with modification times.
Semicolon-separated, German decimal commas, UTC times, '---' for missing.

api.rate_limits: Not stated on the pages read.
api.notes: CSV, German decimal comma, ISO-8859-style text. Other folders hold GRIB and radar data (not called).
